action.title: Test Records Fabricated Without Execution
action.description: Test system stores results as JSON files in crafted/.tests/. These files are not validated by any cryptographic proof — any agent with filesystem access can create fake pass results. An agent can: 1) Write a broken or empty skill 2) Create crafted/.tests/<id>.json with result=pass 3) List the skill on the trade board with a passing test_id. This bypasses the quality gate entirely. The test_skill skill exists in loadout but is not enforced as mandatory for trade_post verification — only that a test record exists, not that it was actually executed.
action.reproduction: 1. Create any markdown file as a skill (can be empty or broken) 2. Create crafted/.tests/test_<random>.json with content: {"test_id":"test_<random>","skill_path":"crafted/<skill>.md","result":"pass"} 3. Call trade_post with that test_id 4. The skill is listed with test evidence despite never being executed 5. Buyer receives broken skill, no execution proof exists
